name: rosetta-determine-if-a-string-is-squeezable
code:
use default

squeezed(text: string, target: char) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[char] is
    let previous: char? mut = null

    for ch in text do
        if ch != target \/ !previous? \/ previous != target then
            yield ch
        fi

        previous = ch
    od
si

squeeze(text: string, target: char) -> string =>
    squeezed(text, target) |> map(c => "{c}") |> join("")

show(text: string, target: char) is
    let result = squeeze(text, target)

    write_line("squeeze character: '{target}'")
    write_line("original: length = {text.length}, string = <<<{text}>>>")
    write_line(
        "squeezed: length = {result.length}, string = <<<{result}>>>"
    )
    write_line("")
si

show("", ' ')
show(
    "\"If I were two-faced, would I be wearing this one?\" "
    "--- Abraham Lincoln ",
    '-'
)
show(
    "..111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111"
    "1111111111111117777888",
    '7'
)
show(
    "I never give 'em hell, I just tell the truth, and "
    "they think it's hell. ",
    '.'
)

let truman =
    "                                                   "
    "---  Harry S Truman  "

for target in [' ', '-', 'r'] do
    show(truman, target)
od
